notes.title: Patch 0.9.1.0
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your feedback this past week! We've heard your requests and have updated the game accordingly.

-Quality settings have been added. This includes scales for shadows, shading, textures, and more. We hope this will allow more players to experience the game.
-Reduced drag and slightly increased player movement speed. We hope this change will help players interact with objects more easily and have a better sense of control over their movement.
-Fixed a number of bugs, including some related to the ADS system with the persistent enemy. These bug fixes should help the game feel more polished overall.
-The escape key can now be used as well as the backspace key to exit menus.
